title: Cyberbullying
meaning: Bullying through phones, social media, games or messages, such as mean messages, humiliating posts, fake accounts or being shut out of group chats.
examples_and_warning_signs: Embarrassing posts or edited images shared about you
Feeling anxious or upset after checking your phone
steps: Take screenshots showing date, time and usernames.
Block the person and report the account on the platform.
If it is serious or continues, report it at cybercrime.gov.in with an adult's help.
seek_immediate_help: Messages include threats to harm you
Private or intimate images are being shared or threatened
You feel unsafe or very low
school_support: School counsellor or IT/cyber safety coordinator
